intro: Barnil Stonepot is trying to reconstruct the third chapter of Hemet Nesingwary's hunting manuscript in Stranglethorn Vale. The section recounts the first kill made with a dwarven rifle by Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack, but four specific leaves were blown across the jungle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Chapter III was my favorite. It tells of Sir Erlgadin and Lady Rouack's first kill with a dwarven rifle. And the end of Chapter III, why, such a cliffhanger!
Looks to me as though we still need pages 18, 20, 21 and 24 to finish the chapter. Those pages are out there somewhere...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any luck with pages 18, 20, 21 or 24? Those are the only ones we need to piece together Chapter III.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Phew! Good work, friend. Chapter III is now back together in one piece!
